final_candidates.decision_summary: Position 13 is in the N-terminal activation region outside the Cys-rich zinc-finger core; adding a basic residue may aid cofactor (P-TEFb) recruitment with low structural risk. Confidence is moderate given heuristic-only evidence.
S46 lies just N-terminal of the arginine-rich motif in the core domain; a basic substitution could strengthen TAR/P-TEFb interactions without directly altering the essential ARM residues.
Q60 is C-terminal to the ARM in a flexible region; an extra Arg may modestly enhance RNA/cofactor association with low folding risk, though benefit is expected to be small.

stop_reason.detail: Candidate pool has converged under domain-based heuristics; additional self-iteration without evidence tools would not improve the Top-3.

history.rationale: Adds positive charge within the basic RNA-binding domain (49-57), potentially strengthening TAR binding; conservative substitution of a non-essential Gln.

Increases basicity immediately adjacent to the core arginine-rich domain, which may improve TAR/P-TEFb interactions without disrupting essential residues.

Proline-rich region mutation increasing positive charge; H13 is not essential for transactivation, and added charge may aid nuclear localization/TAR interaction.
